voice.summary: Ledgerline speaks like a well-prepared controller giving a reference: factual, grateful and numerate. It lets customers speak first and attaches a number to every claim.
dos: Pair every quote with a measured result
Name the customer and the sector
Use units and time frames exactly
donts: Do not use vague 'results' without figures
Do not edit a quote beyond clarity

taglines: Results our customers can point at
